The thing is, 'touch' really only exists in the context of defined boundaries. We say that we touch the wall, because we interpret the wall as the flat vertical surface next to us. On a fundamental level, however, that wall is a collection of atoms, themselves composed of particles, which are field excitations. Those particles have wavefunctions (probability density) throughout all of spacetime, including overlapping with the particles that comprise you (albeit incredibly weak interactions). From a QM perspective, you could effectively say that you are touching the wall, even when you are some distance from it.

If this is the case, then I would like you to consider what a bond is. At a fundamental level, bonding is just the formation of two molecular orbitals from two atomic orbitals (i.e. the constructive and destructive interference of those atoms' electrons' wavefunctions). We only interpret it differently because there is a bond energy involved (the bonded form tends to be a local energy minima). The wavefunctions of those electrons still interact, even when not bonded. More importantly, as they are wave-like, they don't have defined boundaries, so even when bonded there is nothing to 'touch' as such.

I play BH as a 4-role roaming support, make sure your safelane can manage without you before you pick, if you have spec and tree you're gonna need to play a lane support, think before you pick him. He's also really strong against invis heroes (obviously), squishy supports (especially solo supports), Mid laners that need a good start (eg shadow fiend) and junglers that are likely to get low or get disrupted easily (killing axe's tranqs, doom/legion/bloodseeker always get low).

When you start off buy an orb of venom, a set of tangoes, and a few clarities, if needed buy the courier for your team (the other support is solo, you will have to do this fairly often, don't be mean about it), it's cheaper than the wards. Level invis first, then you want to go to the rune nearest your offlane, go invis at 10s till the horn and grab it, spam right click and stop to get it easily while staying invis. Then go bot, you want to get level 2, but you can still harass, run up to them, hit them as long as you can get away with before they hit you back, then go invis and wait for the cd. Do this a couple of times and you can take off a lot of their regen, paying back your offlaner for the exp you steal.

Level jinada, go mid, tell you're mid you're coming, tell him to let the enemy wave push (so that they are as far forward as possible) then when they're as forward as you think they'll go hit them for the jinada slow, you don't have to hit them again for 3s to keep the slow, so just body block them for 2s then hit them to refresh the oov slow. This should be an easy kill if your mid has any clue how to play, you should be near level 3.

Head back by your mid tower, regen up using the clarities/tangoes as needed. The enemy mid will tp back to lane and you can kill them again in exactly the same manner, if you want you can wait till you have level 3 for the level in shuriken, making the kill even easier.

Your item build should be brown boots, urn (get the gauntlets first), then phase or mana boots. I often follow this with orchid, dagon or deso, depending on the teams. Does your team have damage but little control? Orchid. Does your team have control but little damage? Deso. Does the enemy team have really squishy heroes? Deso or dagon. (dagon is more a trolly option, but it's still really strong). After that play to the strengths of the first item, if orchid consider hex, if dagon consider eth blade, if deso build more damage (s&y is a good one).

Your skill build should be invis>jinada>shuri>shuri>shuri>track>shuri then max invis, then jinada, you can get levels in jinada earlier if you like and are going for deso, otherwise the invis is better.

Keep the enemy on their toes, if they place a sentry, alt-click the clock, time that fucker and gank in 4 mins time just as it expires. Keep on top of their jungler if they have one, deny an axe's tranqs, steal a BS's kill so he doesn't get the health back etc. Don't stay in a lane and farm, go from kill to kill, make shit happen. If you can't kill their carry, harass the fuck out of them, force them to base, to play far too safe to farm, all that shit. Their mid should have lost lane from the two kills earlier, RUB IT IN, kill them some more.

When you get track use it on every kill, this will get you more farm than you know what to do with, the enemy storm spirit that you pwned mid? you just beat him to orchid. That weaver offlane that your shuri claimed 4 times? you just beat him to deso. Buy your own sentries, deward theirs and their observers, ruin their map control as you feed you allies track gold.

By lategame you drop off a bit, if you went orchid keep their cores disabled, if you went deso or dagon nuke the fuck out of their supports, but always keep the tracks up, even as you drop off you get your team shittones of gold (I have a gem that shows track bonus gold, it's gone up 14k in one game before). That is the true worth of BH, he's monstrous in the early game, and he makes your team monstrous in the lategame.

If you have any questions about this feel free to ask.
